subject: Native USDC versus RLUSD on XRPL, AMM depth, native lending amendment status, and institutional payment-rail cross-check

scope_limitations: AMM pools only; XRPL order-book DEX is excluded.
Headline TVL includes XRP-paired pools only; token-token pairs are counted but not dollar-valued in headline TVL.
Most pools have negligible TVL; top ten represented $18.96M or 52.8% of XRP-paired TVL at page snapshot.

circle_usdc_xrpl.top10_account_classification: XRPLWin account pages label the ten largest balances as AMM pool accounts; account pages also display vault/loan-broker metadata, but native lending amendments are not active.
provider_limitations: WinDB follows ledger by a few minutes; supply/holder histories are rebuilt from daily balances and retained for two years.
Top-holder account classifications are indexer labels and should be independently checked against raw AMM ledger objects before using concentration as an ownership measure.

data_quality: RLUSD page said live feed unavailable while supply totals were refreshed minutes earlier; 24h net change was stated to agree with independent RPC using 2026-10-31 finalized data.
Pool summary TVL and wallet-reserve snapshot differ in time/ledger; preserve separately and do not average.
Signed daily snapshot is source-published with Ed25519 signature and Merkle path; cryptographic verification was not executed in this run.

native_xrpl_lending.interpretation: Native XRPL vault/loan-broker lending is not live. Account explorer metadata mentioning vaults or loan brokers is not evidence of active lending or collateralized loans.

mastercard.limitation: Mastercard does not publish a stablecoin-by-network matrix or XRPL-specific settlement volumes; initial named partners are not identified as XRPL-anchored.

okx.margin_collateral: Institutional-grade margin collateral in select markets
okx.limitation: RLUSD collateral is not the same as XRP collateral; product availability varies by region.

sg_forge.collateral_use: Opportunity to explore use in Ripple products and trading collateral; not confirmed deployed.

ondo.xrpl_asset_leg: Executed in under five seconds in reported pilot
ondo.fiat_leg: Mastercard MTN triggered instruction; Kinexys by J.P. Morgan and correspondent banking delivered USD to Ripple Singapore bank account

aviva.status: Partnership to explore fund tokenization on XRPL; no tokens issued per dashboard event record.

flutterwave.ripple_relationship: Ripple strategic investment; announcement says RLUSD embedded in payment rails and XRPL used for faster transaction clearing.
flutterwave.circle_relationship: Circle Ventures strategic investment; USDC settlement added across Flutterwave platform.
flutterwave.interpretation: Multi-issuer, multi-chain relationship is confirmed. Current public stablecoin API documentation does not list XRPL and lists RLUSD only on Ethereum; this is disconfirming evidence against assuming the announced XRPL/RLUSD corridor is generally available in production. Private or separate integration is not ruled out.
